rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for wanting or being keen to do or get something.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 aa3

rows.note: Use this when the eagerness includes impatience or urgency, as in not being able to wait.

example.english: I’m eager to know the result and can’t wait.
example.traditional: 我心急，等唔切想知個結果。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sam1 gap1 dang2 m4 cit3 soeng2 zi1 go3 git3 gwo2
